metadata.summary: A large-scale dataset for benchmarking medical question answering, sourced from professional medical board exam questions (USMLE-style), containing 12,723 question-answer pairs with explanations, covering multiple medical specialties and requiring multi-step clinical reasoning; includes a test split of 1,273 questions.
metadata.purpose: To advance research on medical knowledge question answering systems.

ethics.privacy_measures: Data is de-identified and derived from publicly available exam materials; no protected health information (PHI) present.

extraction.notes: Baseline card derived solely from dataset_catalog.xlsx real metadata; remaining fields require paper/README or manual completion.

known_limitations: Derived exclusively from USMLE-style exams, limiting generalizability to non-US medical education systems or practice contexts.
Questions reflect standardized testing format and may not represent real-world clinical decision-making scenarios.
No demographic or subgroup metadata (e.g., age, sex, ethnicity) is associated with questions or answer options.
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: US-centric; reflects US medical curriculum and licensing standards only.
bias_and_limitations.subgroup_coverage: No patient-level demographic subgroups included; questions are not annotated for population relevance.

tasks_and_use.excluded_tasks: Clinical decision support in real-time care settings; direct patient-facing applications without validation.

population.target_population: Candidates taking USMLE-style medical licensing examinations in the United States

annotation.labeling_provenance: Questions and answers sourced from USMLE-style board exams; explanations provided by domain experts.
